purpose: Select a small recoverable subset of representation branches using semantic coverage and explicit display cost.

activities.label: choose branches by marginal semantic coverage under display budget
test source contract budget and MMR authority boundaries

queries.expression: does the selected subset maximize declared marginal semantic coverage without exceeding display budget
do unselected branches remain recoverable and does MMR remain diagnostic only

assumptions: Semantic needs can be declared before human evaluation.
Display cost is an explicit engineering budget, not a physiological measure.
The full/source anchor is valuable as a recoverable reference.
The query contract from 063 is required for every candidate.
kill_tests: The source query contract cannot be bypassed.
An anchor that exceeds budget must block.
MMR cannot become final selection authority.
Unselected branches cannot be deleted silently.
No human data, camera, network or external execution is allowed.
unknowns: Whether semantic weights predict task-adjusted usefulness.
Whether marginal coverage correlates with human comparison effort.
Whether keeping more recoverable branches increases correction quality.
Whether display cost can be estimated across screens and sensory policies.
How to personalize budgets without learning a position-biased click ranking.
